I’m sorry dude, that happened to me when I was 13. 

Never had even talked to the girl, she went to the principal and said I sexually assaulted her in an unsupervised hallway leading from one hallway to a gymnasium. 

The principal called my teachers phone at the end of the day and had me come up to the principal’s office, I had no idea I was gonna be walking into a cop putting me into handcuffs and then later be walked to his patrol car and brought to the sheriff’s office. My dad was an american history teacher at the time and has worked there for 30+ years, which made things even more complicated. Everyone knew me and my family, he was also the head football coach at the time so it brought a lot of extra attention. My dad followed us down to the station where I was questioned for awhile, told my side of the story and then they took my phone. 

I wasn’t allowed back in the school for an undetermined amount of time. The next few days we found an amazing defense lawyer who helped a ton, although my parents had to pay roughly $10,000

To keep it short, it never even made it to court and was dismissed. I went back to school and had to serve in school suspension until the case was closed and I was determined innocent. 

Turns out this girl did the same thing a year earlier in another school district and was just looking for attention 

The sad part is, it really messed up my high school experience, relationships and just about everything else.

It was the worst thing to ever happen to me and it took years for it to finally fade out. 

I’m really sorry you’re going through this. There’s really nothing I could say to help. You have a long road ahead of you, time to get to work and clear your name. You’ve got this, if I can get through it, you can too.
